CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JANUARY 27, 2026

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 5:35 p.m., on
Tuesday, January 27, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Mayor Pro Tern Jesse Zwick (arrived at 5:42 p.m.)
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  Interim City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Assistant City Clerk Maria Dacanay-Wisner

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:35 p.m. to hear the
  5:30 p.m. regular meeting and the 5:35 p.m. concurrently, with Mayor Pro
  Tern Zwick absent. Councilmember Snell led the assemblage in the Pledge
  of Allegiance.

STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember
(LAND  Zernitskaya.
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act.
DISCLOSURE (GC 84308)

AGENDA  Motion by Mavor Torosis. seconded by Councilmember Hall to: approve
MANAGEMENT  staff's request to pull items 4.C. and 11.B.; hear comments on item 16.1.
  (ONESAMO People's Academy) along with item I (General Public Input);
  present the Mayor's Highlight after item I; combine the City Manager's
  Report with item 16.I. and hear both items after Item 2 (Special Agenda
  Items); hear item 12.A. after the Consent Calendar and give priority to hear
  students speaking on items 11.C. and 11.D. upon arrival. The motion passed
  with the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Zernitskaya, Snell, Raskin, Hall, Negrete,
  Mayor Torosis
  NOES:  None

  January 27, 2026
   ABSENT: Mayor Pro Tern Zwick

(Councilmember Zwick  Motion by Councilmember Negrete. seconded bv Councilmember
arrived at 5:42 p.m.)  Zernitskaya to recess from Closed Session at 8:30 p.m. and continue with
  Closed Session after the public session. The motion passed with the
  following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Negrete, Hall, Raskin, Snell, Zernitskaya,
  Mayor Pro Tern Zwick, Mayor Torosis
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

PUBLIC INPUT FOR  Members of the public Denise Barton and Tom Casparian commented on
CLOSED SESSION ONLY:  Closed Session items.

CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 7:22 p.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and returned at 8:30 p.m., with all members present to report
  the following:

  5.A. Conference with legal counsel - existing litigation - Gov. Code §
  54956.9(d)(l): City, et al. v. Waymo LLC et al., LASC # 25SMCV06581

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  5.B. Conference with legal counsel - existing litigation - Gov. Code §
  54956.9(d)(l): Santa Monica EV Holdings, LLC, et al. v. City, LASC #
  25SMCV06681

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  5.C. Conference with legal counsel - existing litigation - Gov. Code §
  54956.9(d)(l): Waymo LLC v. City, LASC # 25SMCV06541

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  2  January 27, 2026
 ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special City Council meeting adjourned at 8:30
  p.m. and the regular City Council continued.
